title: Personal LLM Experiment Mini-Sheet — Diego (Feb 2026)
content:
Mini experiment tracker — quick table and notes (working draft)

Header: exp_id | date | model | q | batch | seq_len | tokens/sec | p50_ms | cost_per_1k_tokens | quality_delta | notes

exp_01 | 2026-02-10 | ggml-13b-slim | q4_0 | 1 | 512 | 2000 | 45 | $0.85 | -0.5% (perp) | baseline, single-thread. Good coherence.
exp_02 | 2026-02-12 | ggml-13b-slim | q4_0 | 4 | 512 | 6200 | 60 | $0.26 | -0.8% | batching improves throughput but p50 increases. Try async batching.
exp_03 | 2026-02-14 | ggml-13b-slim | q8_0 | 4 | 512 | 9600 | 75 | $0.17 | -2.7% | quant8 reduces quality on long-form. Check eval set.
exp_04 | 2026-02-16 | redwood-13b-v2 | q4_0 | 2 | 256 | 3400 | 38 | $0.42 | +0.2% | smaller seq_len helps latency. Compare reranker impact.
exp_05 | 2026-02-20 | redwood-7b | q4_0 | 8 | 128 | 11000 | 22 | $0.12 | -0.1% | low cost; good for short responses.
exp_06 | 2026-02-24 | redwood-13b-v2 | q4_0 | 16 | 512 | 15000 | 95 | $0.08 | -0.6% | stress test for high batch; memory ok.

Quick notes:
- Metrics: tokens/sec measured with synthetic driver (50 reqs warmup). p50 latency measured per request end-to-end (includes routing).
- Cost calc: rough token pricing using internal unit costs (incl infra + infra overhead). See linked confluence page for exact formula.
- Observations:
  * Quant8 (q8_0) gives large throughput wins (x1.5-2) but quality drop on long-answer evals. Consider hybrid: q8 for short responses, q4 for long.
  * Batching improves tokens/sec but increases p50; target depends on SLO. For latency-sensitive endpoints, keep batch <=4.
  * KV/prefix cache might help common prefix workloads — add a small test harness.

TODO / next steps:
- Add standardized eval set (10 prompts) and compute quality_delta as BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim.
- Run exp_03 with 2x longer warmup and compare quality on long-form tasks.
- Hook experiments to dashboard (ticket: jira:INF-1023) and tag runs with model hash + config.
- Quick follow-up: sync with @alex and @maya next Wed; bring draft to eng-applied-ml sync.

Scratch / quick ideas:
- Try mixed-precision (q4 with selective fp16 on attention) — might require runtime patch.
- Note: observed OOM on exp_06 when seq_len=1024 and batch=16; need to log memory stats next run.
